benchmarks.name: simple_alloc
benchmarks.description: Allocates two heap nodes, stores one pointer field, returns root. Minimal pointer manipulation.

benchmarks.name: linked_list_build
benchmarks.description: Builds a 3-node singly-linked list via multiple allocs and next-field stores.

benchmarks.name: dead_pointers
benchmarks.description: Three allocations; two (t1, t2) are dead after allocation. Only result is live at return.

benchmarks.name: aliasing
benchmarks.description: Two variables alias one node. Field store via one alias, load via the other.

benchmarks.name: branch_alloc
benchmarks.description: If/else branch each allocates two nodes. Join point sees two possible HRA states.

benchmarks.name: loop_list
benchmarks.description: Unrolled chain of 3 field loads (p->next chain). Exercises load statement sequencing.

benchmarks.name: multi_field_graph
benchmarks.description: 3 nodes linked bidirectionally via both next and prev fields. 1 dead alloc (tmp). Largest benchmark.

benchmarks.name: genuine_loop
benchmarks.description: While-loop traversing a linked list. Features a genuine CFG back-edge and requires worklist fixpoint iterations.

excluded_candidates.name: free() usage
excluded_candidates.reason: free() is not modelled by the HRA transfer function (mapped to UnknownStmt/ignored). Including programs with free() would produce misleading results. Documented limitation.
excluded_candidates.observed_failure: No explicit failure; free() silently becomes UnknownStmt, producing incorrect heap-shape results.

excluded_candidates.name: Pointer arithmetic
excluded_candidates.reason: The frontend does not recognise pointer arithmetic (p+1, p++, p[i]) as field loads or stores. Such expressions are silently dropped.

excluded_candidates.name: Interprocedural call targets
excluded_candidates.reason: The analysis is intraprocedural. Function calls that return heap objects (other than malloc/__builtin_malloc) are not modelled.
excluded_candidates.observed_failure: CallExpr targets other than malloc become dead statements.

excluded_candidates.name: Unions
excluded_candidates.reason: Union field access is not handled by the frontend FieldDecl-based translation.
